[LLSU.12.1] Typed string interpolation per [LGRA].

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `interp_basic` | `"{binding.slot}"` substitution | manual string-concatenation call target |
| `interp_format_spec` | format specifiers: `:.2f`, `:04d`, `:>10`, `:+.1f`, etc. | pre-format the value via an integrator call target |
| `interp_time_format` | `{t.ts:%H:%M:%S}` strftime-style time formatting | pre-format the value via an integrator call target |
| `interp_path_access` | `{response.forecast[0].max}` path access into structured slots | bind intermediate value via an earlier rule |
| `interp_literal_braces` | `{{` and `}}` for literal `{` and `}` | not generally avoidable once `interp_basic` is on |
